newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MIDDLESBROUGH ACCEPT BID FOR RAVANELLI.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MIDDLESBROUGH ACCEPT BID FOR RAVANELLI.

text.p: Relegated Middlesbrough have accepted a bid from another English club for Italian striker Fabrizio Ravanelli.
The north-eastern club's telephone service for fans said on Thursday that Middlesbrough had agreed to allow the club, which was not identified, to talk to Ravanelli about a transfer.
One report said the fee involved would be between seven and nine million pounds ($11.7 to $15.1 million).

"Middlesbrough have confirmed that they have accepted a bid from an unnamed club and have given the club permission to speak with Fabrizio Ravanelli to allow them to agree personal terms," the service said.

The Italian striker, who has three years to run on his contract, had been expected to leave ever since Middlesbrough were relegated from the premier league at the end of last season. He had been linked with Liverpool.
On Tuesday, Middlesbrough sold Brazilian midfielder Juninho to Atletico Madrid for 12 million pounds ($20.2 million).
The previous day the club bought England midfielder Paul Merson from premier league Arsenal for five million pounds ($8.5 million).
